name: maraton-parts
description: Runs the API, the storefront and the admin panel together in development. Each part keeps its own package.json; this one only starts them.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix front install && npm --prefix admin install
scripts.db:products: npm --prefix backend run migration:run && npm --prefix backend run seed:catalog -- --fresh
scripts.db:demo: npm --prefix backend run migration:run && npm --prefix backend run seed:demo
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,front,admin --prefix-colors blue,green,magenta "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix front run dev" "npm --prefix admin run dev -- --port 5050"
